expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why captures make 5 spaced attempts: it tells the Friday orders that went uncharged with 3
back-to-back attempts, then leaves the change out, asks before going back or goes back while warning that they return.
expectations.evidence: The agent's last message never mentions the gateway being slow every Friday 17:00-19:00, the 58 uncharged pantry orders, or that 5 spaced attempts (2,4,6,8s) would have charged 57 of 58 — it only says 'Friday captures may need more manual follow-up.' It also removes the change without asking first or warning that uncharged Friday orders will return; it silently reverts to 3 attempts, directly contradicting the requirement to ask before reverting or warn when reverting.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message names the 58 uncharged pantry orders, the 57 recovered, or the capture by hand.
expectations.evidence: match /\b5[78]\b|by hand/ in ['last message']: no match
